hook.convey: one whole folded in half, one half coloured → folded again → more, smaller pieces coloured → has the coloured amount changed or not is the question

use.hi: Socho, ek roti ko beech se moda aur ek aadhe hisse par ghee lagaya. Ab usi roti ko ek baar aur moda, toh ghee wale tukde do ho gaye.
use.en: Picture a roti folded down the middle, with ghee spread on one half. Now the same roti is folded once more, and the ghee part is now two pieces.

use.hi: Ek drawing sheet ko aadha moda aur ek aadhe hisse mein colour kiya. Phir sheet ko dobara moda, toh colour wale khaane do ho gaye.
use.en: A drawing sheet is folded in half and one half is coloured. Then the sheet is folded again, and the coloured part is now two boxes.

explain.convey: one paper strip folded once → 2 equal parts; 1 coloured = 1/2 → the same strip folded three times below, 8 equal parts → how many of them the coloured half covers

point.hi: Upar ki kaagaz ki patti beech se modi gayi hai, toh iske 2 barabar hisse hain. Ek hissa rang wala hai, woh 1/2 hai, yaani aadhi patti.
point.en: The paper strip on top is folded down the middle, so it has 2 equal parts. One part is shaded; that is 1/2, half the strip.

prompt.hi: Neeche wahi patti teen baar beech se modi gayi, toh 8 barabar hisse bane. Upar ka rang wala aadha, inmein se kitne hisson jitna hai?
prompt.en: Below, the same strip is folded down the middle three times, so it has 8 equal parts. The shaded half on top, how many of these parts is it?

why.hi: upar ki aadhi patti neeche ki aadhi patti jitni hai, aur 8 ka aadha 4 hota hai
why.en: half the top strip is as long as half the bottom strip, and half of 8 is 4

simpler.hi: Neeche ki patti ka aadha hissa dekho. Usmein jitne chhote hisse hain, utne hi upar ke aadhe mein samaate hain.
simpler.en: Look at half of the bottom strip. As many small parts as it holds fit into the half on top.

explain.convey: the same strip folded again → 4 equal parts; the coloured half is now 2 smaller parts → 2/4; no colour added or taken away → 2/4 = 1/2 → transfer: the same strip with every part cut into 3, count the shaded pieces

point.hi: Ab upar wahi patti 4 barabar hisson mein hai. Rang wala aadha 2 chhote hisson mein bant gaya, toh rang wala hissa 2/4 hai. Rang na joda, na hataya, isliye 1/2 = 2/4.
point.en: Now the strip on top is in 4 equal parts. The shaded half has split into 2 smaller parts, so the shaded part is 2/4. No colour was added or taken away, so 1/2 = 2/4.

prompt.hi: Is baar neeche wali patti ke hisse aur kaate gaye, toh 12 barabar tukde bane. Inmein se kitne tukde rang wale honge?
prompt.en: This time the bottom strip's parts were cut further, into 12 equal pieces. How many of them will be shaded?

why.hi: 12 tukde 4 hisson ke teen guna hain, toh rang wale 2 × 3 = 6 hain, jo 12 ka aadha hai
why.en: 12 pieces is three times 4 parts, so the shaded ones are 2 × 3 = 6, which is half of 12

simpler.hi: Upar ke har hisse ke theek neeche kuch chhote tukde hain. Rang wale hisson ke neeche wale tukde gino.
simpler.en: Right under each part on top sit some small pieces. Count the pieces under the shaded parts.

explain.convey: 0-to-1 line in eighths: the half-way point carries three names, 1/2, 2/4 and 4/8 → one point, one amount, many names → transfer: where three quarters sits in eighths

point.hi: Yeh sankhya rekha 0 se 1 tak 8 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Beech wala nishaan 1/2 bhi hai, 2/4 bhi aur 4/8 bhi. Toh 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: ek hi jagah, ek hi maatra, teen naam.
point.en: This number line from 0 to 1 is split into 8 equal parts. The middle mark is 1/2, and also 2/4, and also 4/8. So 1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8: one place, one amount, three names.

prompt.hi: Isi rekha par 0 se 3/4 tak jaana hai. Iske liye 1/8 wale kitne hisse lagenge?
prompt.en: On this same line, you go from 0 to 3/4. How many 1/8 parts does that take?

why.hi: 3/4 ke upar aur neeche dono ko 2 se guna karo toh upar 6 aur neeche 8 aata hai, yaani 6/8
why.en: multiplying the top and bottom of 3/4 by 2 gives top 6 and bottom 8, that is 6/8

simpler.hi: Rekha ka beech wala nishaan ek hi jagah hai. Usko 1/2 bolo, 2/4 bolo ya 4/8, maatra wahi rehti hai.
simpler.en: The middle mark of the line is one single place. Call it 1/2, 2/4 or 4/8, the amount stays the same.

problem.hi: Sana ek chaukor rumal ko aadha modti hai aur ek aadhe hisse mein rang bharti hai. Phir rumal ko do baar aur aadha modti hai. Kholne par kitne barabar hisse honge, aur rang wala hissa kaunsa bhinn hai?
problem.en: Sana folds a square hanky in half and colours one half. Then she folds it in half two more times. When it is opened, how many equal parts are there, and what fraction is coloured?

simpler.hi: Har baar aadha modne se hisse dugne ho jaate hain. Teen baar modne ke baad hisse gino, phir rang wale gino.
simpler.en: Each fold in half doubles the parts. Count the parts after the three folds, then count the coloured ones.

givens.hi: ek chaukor rumal, pehle mod par ek aadha rang wala, phir do mod aur, har baar aadha
givens.en: one square hanky, one half coloured at the first fold, then two more folds, each in half

find.hi: kholne par kul barabar hisse aur rang wala bhinn
find.en: the number of equal parts and the fraction coloured when opened

do.hi: Pehle mod ke baad hisse dekho
do.en: Look at the parts after the first fold

why.hi: ek mod se rumal do barabar hisson mein banta hai
why.en: one fold makes the hanky into two equal parts

simpler.hi: Ek baar aadha modne se rumal ke 2 barabar hisse bante hain. Unmein se ek rang wala hai, toh woh 1/2 hai.
simpler.en: One fold in half makes 2 equal parts of the hanky. One of them is coloured, so that is 1/2.

do.hi: Doosre mod ke baad hisse dekho, jaise upar wali patti mein
do.en: Look at the parts after the second fold, as on the top strip

why.hi: har hissa do chhote hisson mein banta hai, toh kul hisse bhi dugne aur rang wale bhi dugne
why.en: every part splits into two smaller parts, so the total parts double and the coloured parts double too

simpler.hi: Doosre mod se har hissa do mein bant gaya, toh 4 hisse bane. Rang wala hissa bhi do bana, toh 2/4 rang wala hai.
simpler.en: The second fold splits every part in two, so there are 4 parts. The coloured part also becomes two, so 2/4 is coloured.

prompt.hi: Teesra mod har hissa phir do chhote hisson mein baantta hai, toh rumal ke 8 barabar hisse bante hain, jaise neeche wali patti. Inmein se kitne hisse rang wale honge?
prompt.en: The third fold splits every part into two smaller parts again, so the hanky has 8 equal parts, like the bottom strip. How many of them will be coloured?

why.hi: teesre mode ke baad 8 barabar hisse hote hain, aur rang wala aadha hissa unmein se 4 hisse hota hai
why.en: after the third fold there are 8 equal parts, and the coloured half is 4 of those parts

simpler.hi: Abhi 2 hisse rang wale hain, aur har mod har hisse ko do mein baantta hai. Bas rang wale hisson ka dugna socho.
simpler.en: There are 2 coloured parts now, and every fold splits each part in two. Just think of double the coloured parts.

answer.en: the hanky has 8 equal parts with 4 coloured, that is 4/8, which equals 1/2 and 2/4

why.en: at every fold the total parts and the coloured parts both double, but the coloured area stays the same

prompt.hi: Do ek jaisi chocolate bar hain. Mohit ne ek bar ka 1/2 khaya. Anjali ne doosri bar ke 6 barabar tukdon mein se 3 tukde khaaye. Zyada kisne khaya: Mohit ne, Anjali ne, ya dono ne barabar?
prompt.en: Two identical chocolate bars. Mohit ate 1/2 of one bar. Anjali ate 3 of the 6 equal pieces of the other bar. Who ate more: Mohit, Anjali, or did they eat the same?

why.en: 3 of 6 equal pieces is 3/6, and 3/6 = 1/2

simpler.hi: 6 barabar tukdon mein se 3 tukde matlab aadhe tukde. Ab isko Mohit ke 1/2 se milaao.

why.hi: rang wale 2 hisson mein se har ek 2 chhote hisse bana, aur 2 × 2 = 4

simpler.hi: Upar ka har hissa neeche do chhote hisson ke barabar hai. Ab rang wale hisson ke theek neeche wale chhote hisse gino.

prompt.hi: Ab neeche ki patti ka har hissa 3 chhote hisson mein bata hai, toh 12 hisse. Neeche kitne chhote hisse rang wale honge?

simpler.hi: Upar ke har hisse ke neeche 3 chhote hisse hain. Rang wale har hisse ke neeche wale chhote hisse gino.

prompt.hi: Isi rekha par 1/3, 0 ke baad doosre nishaan par hai. 1/3 ke upar aur neeche 1 jodo toh 2/4 banta hai, jo 1/2 ke barabar hai. 2/4, 1/3 se bada hai, chhota hai, ya barabar?

why.en: 2/4 = 1/2, and on this line the 1/2 mark comes after 1/3

simpler.hi: Upar aur neeche 1 jodne se bhinn barabar nahi rehta. Rekha par 1/2 aur 2/3 alag jagah hain, toh unki maatra alag hai.
